WITH RECURSIVE reset_nodes AS ( SELECT s.id, s.task_id, s.step_key FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} AND s.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND JSON_VALID(s.output_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.output_json, '$.degraded')) = 'true' UNION SELECT child.id, child.task_id, child.step_key FROM app_agent_step child JOIN reset_nodes parent ON parent.task_id = child.task_id AND JSON_VALID(child.depends_on_json) AND JSON_CONTAINS(child.depends_on_json, JSON_QUOTE(parent.step_key)) WHERE child.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SKIPPED') ) UPDATE app_agent_step s JOIN reset_nodes reset_node ON reset_node.id = s.id SET s.status = CASE WHEN s.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND JSON_VALID(s.output_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.output_json, '$.degraded')) = 'true' THEN 'READY' WHEN s.status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'SKIPPED') THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE s.status END, s.error_code = NULL, s.error_message = NULL, s.lease_owner = NULL, s.lease_until = NULL, s.finished_at = NULL, s.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, tenant_key AS tenantKey, max_daily_tokens AS maxDailyTokens, max_daily_cost AS maxDailyCost, max_daily_tasks AS maxDailyTasks, daily_task_date AS dailyTaskDate, daily_task_reserved AS dailyTaskReserved, enabled, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_tenant_budget WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.tenant_key AS tenantKey, b.max_daily_tokens AS maxDailyTokens, b.max_daily_cost AS maxDailyCost, b.max_daily_tasks AS maxDailyTasks, b.daily_task_reserved AS dailyTaskReserved, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(l.token_usage, 0)) FROM app_agent_usage_ledger l WHERE l.tenant_key = b.tenant_key AND l.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS tokenUsage, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(l.cost_amount, 0)) FROM app_agent_usage_ledger l WHERE l.tenant_key = b.tenant_key AND l.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS costUsage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task t WHERE t.tenant_key = b.tenant_key AND t.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS taskCount FROM app_agent_tenant_budget b JOIN app_agent_tenant t ON t.tenant_key = b.tenant_key WHERE b.enabled = 1 AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (b.max_daily_tokens > 0 OR b.max_daily_cost > 0 OR b.max_daily_tasks > 0)

mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.step_id AS stepId, a.artifact_key AS artifactKey, a.artifact_type AS artifactType, a.name, a.version, a.status, a.uri, a.content_hash AS contentHash, a.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.metadata_json AS metadataJson, a.content_json AS contentJson, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_artifact a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} AND a.artifact_key = #{artifactKey} AND a.version = #{version} LIMIT 1

ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN t.status IN ('WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION') THEN 1 WHEN t.status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id, t.id AS taskId, t.task_key AS taskKey, t.task_type AS taskType, t.title, t.objective, t.constraints_json AS constraintsJson, t.status, t.risk_level AS riskLevel, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.tenant_key AS tenantKey, t.priority, t.max_steps AS maxSteps, t.max_retries AS maxRetries, t.max_runtime_seconds AS maxRuntimeSeconds, t.max_tokens AS maxTokens, t.max_cost AS maxCost, t.current_step_id AS currentStepId, t.total_steps AS totalSteps, t.completed_steps AS completedSteps, t.retry_count AS retryCount, t.token_usage AS tokenUsage, t.cost_amount AS costAmount, t.artifact_count AS artifactCount, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.finished_at AS finishedAt, COALESCE(t.last_error, '') AS lastError, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_task t WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.task_id AS taskId, s.plan_id AS planId, s.step_key AS stepKey, s.step_name AS stepName, s.agent_role AS agentRole, s.step_type AS stepType, s.status, s.depends_on_json AS dependsOnJson, s.tool_name AS toolName, s.input_json AS inputJson, s.output_json AS outputJson, s.output_summary AS outputSummary, s.attempt_count AS attemptCount, s.max_attempts AS maxAttempts, s.risk_level AS riskLevel, s.lease_owner AS leaseOwner, s.lease_until AS leaseUntil, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, s.started_at AS startedAt, s.finished_at AS finishedAt, COALESCE(s.error_code, '') AS errorCode, COALESCE(s.error_message, '') AS errorMessage, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_step s WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.task_id AS taskId, c.step_id AS stepId, s.step_name AS stepName, s.tool_name AS toolName, c.tool_definition_id AS toolDefinitionId, c.attempt, c.idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, c.status, c.input_hash AS inputHash, c.input_summary AS inputSummary, c.output_summary AS outputSummary, c.output_ref AS outputRef, c.error_code AS errorCode, c.error_message AS errorMessage, c.duration_ms AS durationMs, c.provider, c.model_name AS modelName, c.token_usage AS tokenUsage, c.cost_amount AS costAmount, c.started_at AS startedAt, c.finished_at AS finishedAt, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM app_agent_tool_call c LEFT JOIN app_agent_step s ON s.id = c.step_id WHERE c.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeededCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCalls, COALESCE(SUM(token_usage), 0) AS toolTokenUsage, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS toolCostAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN token_usage = 0 AND cost_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpricedCalls FROM app_agent_tool_call WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT e.id, e.task_id AS taskId, e.step_id AS stepId, e.event_seq AS eventSeq, e.event_type AS eventType, e.visibility, e.summary, e.payload_json AS payloadJson, e.created_at AS createdAt FROM app_agent_event e WHERE e.task_id = #{taskId} AND e.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND e.event_seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY e.event_seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.task_id AS taskId, a.step_id AS stepId, a.artifact_key AS artifactKey, a.artifact_type AS artifactType, a.name, a.version, a.status, a.uri, a.content_hash AS contentHash, a.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.metadata_json AS metadataJson, a.content_json AS contentJson, a.created_at AS createdAt, a.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_artifact a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC

where.if: AND (a.artifact_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.task_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_agent_workflow_template ( workflow_key, version, display_name, description, task_type, steps_json, allowed_roles_json, allowed_tools_json, max_steps, max_runtime_seconds, max_tokens, max_cost, failure_policy, approval_required, enabled, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{workflowKey}, #{version}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{taskType}, #{stepsJson}, #{allowedRolesJson}, #{allowedToolsJson}, #{maxSteps}, #{maxRuntimeSeconds}, #{maxTokens}, #{maxCost}, #{failurePolicy}, #{approvalRequired}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

if.if: AND ((t.max_tokens > 0 AND t.token_usage >= t.max_tokens) OR (t.max_cost > 0 AND t.cost_amount >= t.max_cost))
AND NOT ((t.max_tokens > 0 AND t.token_usage >= t.max_tokens) OR (t.max_cost > 0 AND t.cost_amount >= t.max_cost))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS taskCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.max_tokens), 0) AS tokenBudget, COALESCE(SUM(t.token_usage), 0) AS tokenUsage, COALESCE(SUM(t.max_cost), 0) AS costBudget, COALESCE(SUM(t.cost_amount), 0) AS costUsage, SUM(CASE WHEN (t.max_tokens > 0 AND t.token_usage >= t.max_tokens) OR (t.max_cost > 0 AND t.cost_amount >= t.max_cost) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overBudgetTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.token_usage = 0 AND t.cost_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpricedTasks FROM app_agent_task t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_agent_task t

SELECT t.id, t.task_key AS taskKey, t.task_type AS taskType, t.title, t.status, t.tenant_key AS tenantKey, t.max_tokens AS maxTokens, t.token_usage AS tokenUsage, t.max_cost AS maxCost, t.cost_amount AS costAmount, CASE WHEN (t.max_tokens > 0 AND t.token_usage >= t.max_tokens) OR (t.max_cost > 0 AND t.cost_amount >= t.max_cost) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overBudget, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM app_agent_task t
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS evaluationCount, COALESCE(AVG(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.score')) AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) AS averageScore, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.verdict')) = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.verdict')) = 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warnCount, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.verdict')) = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failCount, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.evaluationGatePassed')) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gatePassedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.evaluationGatePassed')) = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gateFailedCount FROM app_agent_artifact a INNER JOIN app_agent_task t ON t.id = a.task_id WHERE a.artifact_key = 'agent-evaluation' AND t.task_type = #{taskType} AND t.tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.verdict')) = #{verdict} AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.score')) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) >= #{minimumScore} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json, '$.evaluationGatePassed')) = CASE WHEN #{gatePassed} = TRUE THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END
